Blank Summoning Skillbook is an ingredient used to create Summoning skillbooks.

Characteristics

[edit | edit source]

Blank summoning skillbook is a book which when combined with an appropriate scroll containing a summoning spell, may create a skillbook of said spell.

Base blank summoning skillbook can be used to craft summoning skills from Starter to Adept tier (up to level 9 skills). High tier blank summoning skillbook can be used to craft summoning skillbooks of all tiers.
